objective: Build two winter traffic engines before demand arrives: Michigan Ice for water-specific ice-condition intent and Michigan XC for planning plus conditions handoff. Score improvements against usefulness, search capture, freshness, differentiation, trust, and retention instead of shipping isolated features.

dimensions.definition: Own distinct Michigan winter queries with indexable, non-cannibalizing search surfaces.
Help a visitor make the next real decision quickly rather than merely presenting data.
Use current authoritative observations where they materially improve the decision.
Cover enough Michigan waters/trails and local differences to create a meaningful long-tail moat.
Show source, recency, limitations, and off-season/no-data states honestly.
Compose data and local context into something stronger than a directory or raw feed.
Never convert weather/model signals into unsupported grooming or ice-safety claims.
Give a useful next step into the other winter product without keyword cannibalization.

fatalPenalties.trigger: Any claim that modeled, weather, satellite, camera, or remote data makes ice safe or verifies local thickness.
Any claim that a trail is open/groomed today based only on weather or snow data rather than an operator/groomer report.
Changing the xcski production deployment without recovering its source and deployment ownership.
Editing generated Michigan Ice HTML rather than its generator and regenerating outputs.
Breaking canonical/indexability or creating competing URLs for the same primary intent.
Presenting parent-Great-Lake satellite ice cover as a measurement of a specific bay or fishing location.
Presenting live-looking data without timestamps, no-data handling, or source transparency.

baseline.sourceWindow: Google Search Console export through 2026-08-13 plus repository/product audit on 2026-08-18

largestLosses: Search visibility is far behind the quality of the product.
Only six water-specific search surfaces exist despite strong local differences.
The next-step winter handoff is present but not prominent on water pages.

xc.penaltyReason: A 15-point governance/operability penalty is applied while the live XC source and deployment are not recovered. This is not a content-quality penalty; it prevents claiming the live product is fully maintainable.
largestLosses: Live source/deployment ownership is not recovered.
Grooming truth remains fragmented across operators and community reports.
The planning hub needs a faster comparison layer and clearer source hierarchy.

xcControlledSurface.note: The ownership penalty remains until the actual xcski source/deployment is recovered.

activeSeasonOutcomeTargets.principle: Use preseason scores as build-quality gates. Search Console outcomes remain the real market test once winter demand arrives.
